verdict.rationale: The evidence documents that SendGrid's Event Webhook and Inbound Parse webhook post data to a URL the user controls. Nothing in the pack mentions signed payloads, signature headers, public-key verification, or verification code samples. Webhook delivery alone does not establish authenticity verification, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can verify webhook authenticity — signed payloads with documented signature verification code — so spoofed events can't poison my delivery state
